black.$description: bg--black* section fill. 4.x: background-color: variables.$secondary (_background-mixins.scss) = var(--brand-secondary) — a brand channel, NOT flat black; a flat alias here would re-ship the Buttons grayscale bug at section scale.

gray.$description: bg--gray* section fill. 4.x: variables.$light -> var(--uids-light) -> gray/100 — a legacy core alias, not a brand channel; flat.

white.$description: bg--white* section fill. 4.x: variables.$white = the literal #fff (_variables.scss); flat.

default.$description: The --transparent-border role: default subtle border on light/ambient backgrounds. 4.x consumers include @mixin border, .media--border, the background system overrides, and the list-group rules.

on-dark.$description: Border color inside [class*='bg--black'] ancestors — the border mixin's override (_utilities.scss) and _background.scss's matching selector block.scss swap to consume.

text.$description: 4.x: color: variables.$secondary for type 'light' (_background-mixins.scss, bg-fg-colors mixin) — applies to gold/gray/white backgrounds.
4.x: color: variables.$white for type 'dark' (_background-mixins.scss); $white is the literal #fff (_variables.scss), not $primary/$secondary — stays FLAT, no brandChannel.
